Hosted source-parity, stateful-roundtrip and scale/capacity proof

actions.required_owner_action: Approve the exact write-capable tools and repositories, confirm protected-branch policy and audit retention, and authorize a bounded live-write verifier.
actions.codex_boundary: Current contracts remain dry-run/read-only; Codex must not silently activate writes.

owner_scope_decision.repositories_excluded: All other repositories, forks and organisations of the account.
owner_scope_decision.branches_allowed: Only the active working branch, regardless of name prefix. The claude/ prefix is historical and carries no ownership meaning.
owner_scope_decision.branches_forbidden: main - no direct write, no force push, no merge without explicit owner release approval.
mcp_write_allowlist: git: only on the active working branch
mcp_write_explicitly_excluded: C:\Users\immer\.codex (Codex configuration directory, outside the repository)
any path outside the project working tree

audit_retention.fail_closed_rule: A write without a successfully persisted audit entry counts as failed and must be rolled back, mirroring the auth credential issuance pattern.
